messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden spike in 504/timeouts from eu-central ingress at 2048123402. 5xx rate 23% across /v1/chat and embeddings. paging oncall-sre.
Ava Patel: I'm taking triage. Initial glance shows high TIME_WAIT and accept queue drops on edge-proxy pod set eu-central-*. Ravi can you join for routing/handoff? @CS-Bridge please hold until we have consumer impact.
Ravi Menon: joining. ETA 1m. Do we have Dedicated tenants in eu-central impacted?
CS-Bridge: CS: two enterprise customers reporting degraded API responses, one on Dedicated, one hosted. both seeing 504s around 2048123410.
Sam Ortega: tcpdump on edge-proxy-3 shows SYN followed by RST from gateway side, and upstream connections stuck in SYN_SENT. Could be NAT exhaustion on the egress nodes.
Tessa Liu: infra-bot shows NAT node allocation at 98% ephemeral port utilization for region eu-central. also increasing connection queue length.
infra-bot: action: create_hotfix_ticket id=HOT-204812 created by Ava Patel
Ava Patel: quick mitigation plan: 1) shift 30% of traffic to fallback region eu-north 2) throttle long-lived connections at ingress 3) restart edge-proxy pool one-by-one 4) enable short-circuit FallbackModel for retries for Dedicated customers.
Ravi Menon: I'll apply route update. staging cross-region split now: command run:
```
redwoodctl routes split --route /v1/chat --regions eu-central=70 eu-north=30 --id split-204812
```
Sam Ortega: starting rolling restart of edge-proxy pods gw-21..gw-24. will drain connections gracefully.
CS-Bridge: messaging customers: "We are diverting part of traffic to alternate region and performing mitigations. We will update in 15 minutes." sending now.
Ava Patel: after first restart, accept backlog drops from 4096 to 512 on gw-21. seeing immediate improvement on that host.
Sam Ortega: logs show repeated "accept: resource temporarily unavailable" in proxy, and large counts of TIME_WAIT sockets. suspect kernel tuning needed.
Tessa Liu: temp kernel adjustments applied by infra-bot: lowered tcp_fin_timeout and increased ephemeral port range on NAT nodes.
infra-bot: sysctl changes applied: net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=15000 61000, net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30
Ravi Menon: traffic split is live. eu-north receiving ~28% of new connections. overall 5xx rate dropping from 23% -> 9% in 60s.
Ava Patel: enabling circuit-breaker rule to fast-fail new upstream handshakes after 100ms so clients get quick error instead of long timeouts.
Sam Ortega: enabling short-circuit to FallbackModel for the Dedicated customer key tenant: key=acct-enterprise-42. Their SDK shows retries succeeded against FallbackModel.
CS-Bridge: Customer update: "We have partially mitigated the issue by diverting traffic and restarting proxies. Some requests may still see errors. ETA for resolution 30m." Customers acknowledged.
Ravi Menon: noticing one gateway still high fd_count. I'm isolating that node and draining traffic off it.
Ava Patel: can we patch proxy to reduce accept backlog default from 4096 to 1024? if leak in connection pooling persists we need that hotfix.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: hotfix/proxy-accept-backlog --target=edge-proxy --change=4096->1024
Sam Ortega: applied hotfix to canary pod, observed reduced backlog and fewer 504s for that pod.
Tessa Liu: net metrics: region eu-central 5xx now 3.7% at 2048123560, p95 latency back to normal ranges. Connection TIME_WAIT counts dropping.
Ava Patel: keeping 30% split for 20m, will progressively shift back if stable. preserving all logs/spans and deploying an incident ticket for eng-runtime to investigate pool leak.
Ravi Menon: created task RT-204812 for eng-runtime to triage connection pooling behavior and NAT capacity planning.
CS-Bridge: sent final customer message: "Services returning to normal. We'll follow up with a detailed incident report."
Ava Patel: incident status=mitigated but still monitoring. mitigation window approx 2048123402-2048123565. Good triage team. I'll own postmortem and set sync with eng-runtime tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, severity=high, incident_id=INC-2048123456, start_ts=2048123402, mitigated_ts=2048123565
Ravi Menon: leaving monitoring to Ava. I'll drop the cross-region split to 90/10 in 20m and then 100% if stable.
Ava Patel: noted. closing channel for new action items but keeping thread for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:"
